workflow_scale_routing.rationale: The approved Beat Plan has multiple beats, but the movement can be realized as one structured artifact unless a medium plan accepts cumulative expansion.
reroute_triggers: Artist requests dependent parts, a sequence or series, durable canon, or long-form drafting across sessions.

story_structure.name: Public Private Reframe
story_structure.core_movement: A small private practice is revealed as public infrastructure without becoming sentimental proof.
story_structure.adaptation_summary: The article moves from a concrete overlooked object, through hidden labor, into a civic reframing that asks the reader to notice maintenance as care.
story_structure.turn_logic: The reader expects a lifestyle anecdote, then discovers the hook is really about who keeps shared places alive.
story_structure.compression_rule: Keep each beat tied to one visible garden detail and one pressure shift.
story_structure.expansion_rule: Expand only by adding examples of maintenance, not by adding policy exposition.
failure_modes: the article becomes a generic neighborhood-good story
the hook overpromises conflict the piece does not carry
the ending tells the reader what to believe instead of changing what they notice

beats.one_move_summary: A muddy child's shoe beside a garden gate turns the reader toward an ordinary object that feels out of place.
beats.before_state: The garden reads as a small pleasant local scene.
beats.after_state: The misplaced shoe makes the scene feel like evidence of a larger unseen story.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: A garden article will begin with seasonal beauty or neighborhood charm.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The first image is a lost, muddy object that implies use, absence, and care.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The hook creates curiosity without manufacturing scandal.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Tenderness is crossed with unease about what shared spaces ask of people.

beats.intended_feeling: curious tenderness sharpened by a small disturbance
beats.emotional_payload: The ordinary object opens a civic question without naming it yet.

tension_profile.name: Charm / Evidence
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps the garden from becoming only a pleasant backdrop

tension_profile.name: Presence / Absence
tension_profile.emotional_function: makes the missing child and unseen caretakers active in the scene

source_evidence: Invented reference detail: one small shoe left beside a green gate.
must_preserve: start with the shoe rather than the thesis
keep curiosity humane instead of sensational

pivot_options.label: caretaker
pivot_options.next_move: Reveal the unseen maintenance routine behind the inviting scene.
pivot_options.rationale: This lets the hook turn into labor rather than remain a cute anecdote.

medium_translation_notes.text: Use the shoe as the hook image and delay the thesis until the second section.

traceability_notes.note: The artist wants overlooked maintenance to feel emotionally visible.

beats.one_move_summary: The article reveals the dawn watering rota and the quiet negotiations that keep the garden open.
beats.before_state: The reader is following a mystery around one object.
beats.after_state: The reader sees the garden as a web of uncredited coordination.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: The hook will explain who lost the shoe.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The explanation widens to the adults who water, unlock, repair, and remember.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The expected answer is displaced by a more meaningful system.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Warmth meets fatigue; care becomes real because it costs time.

beats.emotional_payload: The article makes hidden labor feel specific without making anyone heroic.

tension_profile.name: Private Effort / Public Benefit
tension_profile.emotional_function: turns maintenance into the article's central civic pressure

tension_profile.name: Warmth / Fatigue
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps care from reading as effortless niceness

source_evidence: Invented reference detail: three neighbors rotate watering before work.

pivot_options.label: reframe
pivot_options.next_move: Name the garden as civic infrastructure in miniature.
pivot_options.rationale: The labor reveal earns a broader claim without starting as abstraction.

medium_translation_notes.text: Use the second section to convert hook curiosity into the article promise.

traceability_notes.note: The transformation should make care visible through maintenance details.

beats.one_move_summary: The ending asks the reader to notice the repaired latch, full barrel, and swept path before praising the garden.
beats.before_state: The garden has become evidence of maintenance.
beats.after_state: The reader carries a changed noticing practice into other shared places.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: The article will close with gratitude or a call to volunteer.
expectation_turn.actual_result: It closes by changing what the reader is trained to notice.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The payoff is perceptual rather than instructional.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Hope remains modest because the work is ongoing.

beats.intended_feeling: modest civic attention that lingers after the article
beats.emotional_payload: The reader should feel invited to see shared care before demanding a lesson from it.

tension_profile.name: Instruction / Perception
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps the close from becoming a sermon

tension_profile.name: Completion / Ongoing Work
tension_profile.emotional_function: leaves maintenance active after the final line

source_evidence: Invented reference detail: latch, barrel, and swept path are visible signs of care.

pivot_options.label: echo
pivot_options.next_move: Return to the shoe as one sign among many.
pivot_options.rationale: This preserves hook payoff without forcing a solved anecdote.

medium_translation_notes.text: Use the closing section to pay off the hook through changed perception.

traceability_notes.note: The artist wants the ending to create attention rather than instruction.

tension_points.summary: The shared place feels effortless until its hidden maintenance becomes visible.
tension_points.emotional_payload: Care matters because it is repeated, specific, and easy to miss.
source_evidence: Invented reference pattern: shoe, watering rota, repaired latch, full barrel, swept path.

traceability_notes.note: The article's pressure lives between uncredited private work and public ease.
The hook depends on one concrete object rather than abstract thesis.

key_emotional_movements.emotional_shift: curiosity becomes recognition of hidden labor

traceability_notes.note: The reveal must widen from anecdote to care infrastructure.

key_emotional_movements.emotional_shift: recognition becomes a changed habit of noticing

traceability_notes.note: The final movement preserves modest civic attention instead of a moral.

tension_movement_plan.contrast_goal: Each beat should shift the reader's attention: object, labor, perception.

minimum_tension_criteria.waiver_rule: Do not waive adjacent shifts unless the artist explicitly asks for a quiet single-image article.

adjacent_beat_shifts.shift_summary: The article moves from curiosity around an object to recognition of labor.
The article moves from revealed labor to the reader's changed noticing.

tension_movement_plan.reviewer_instruction: Block if the article hook remains a clever opening only, if the middle lacks specific maintenance labor, or if the ending collapses into a generic call to appreciate volunteers.

arc_summary.beginning: A muddy shoe creates a small unsolved question.
arc_summary.turn: The question widens into the unseen labor that keeps the shared garden usable.
arc_summary.ending_or_residue: The reader leaves with a changed practice of noticing maintenance signs.
arc_summary.scale_rationale: Three beats are enough for a hook-driven article because the piece needs one hook, one reframing reveal, and one perceptual payoff.

traceability_summary.note: Safe invented material: the governing meaning is that ordinary maintenance should become visible as shared care.
